newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet fuel stagnant, cargo avails scarce.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet fuel stagnant, cargo avails scarce.

text.p: NWE jet fuel cargoes were quiet on Monday with thin demand meeting very little supply, traders said.

Benchmark Dec IPE futures declined 75 cents to $219.50 a tonne on spread selling in Brent and a statement by trading house AIC that it planned to sell 160,000-190,000 tonnes of gas oil in the ARA market.

The barge market remained long, with premiums around unchanged at Dec +$26. One 10,000 tone cargo loaded from the barge market was offered from Rotterdam. Cargo premiums were stable at Dec IPE +$25 fob NWE.
